Test these items: collection default false when unset, error when multiple values are produced for a non-collection column, collection true multi-value output representation, type URI handling for primitive and non-primitive result expectations, type mismatch reporting for generated/executed columns, tag 0..* parsing with required tag.name and tag.value, database/implementation type-hint tags do not affect base semantics unless explicitly handled. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2.0.0 ViewDefinition.select.column.tag defines the official repeating field `tag` (0..*) with required `tag.name` and `tag.value`; no `tags` column field is defined.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe `.temp/qa/sof_vd04_skeptic_probe.py` expected ParseError for a column using plural `tags`, but parse_view_definition accepted it and canonicalized it into tag metadata.
issues.root_cause: Parser maintained a legacy plural `tags` alias and canonicalized it into official column tag metadata instead of rejecting non-model input.
issues.resolution: Removed the plural alias path; strict parse now rejects `tags` and accepts only official `tag`.
issues.verified_in: SOF-VD-04 SKEPTIC: fresh probe PASS; focused pytest 48 passed; ViewDefinition pytest 943 passed; ViewDefinition conformance 134/134; full conformance 2822/2822.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2.0.0 ViewDefinition.select.column.tag.name and tag.value are both 1..1 string fields; direct serialization and generation must not emit or accept missing/non-string tag metadata.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe mutates ColumnTag("ansi/type", "DATE").name to None after construction. ViewDefinition.to_dict() emitted invalid tag JSON and SQLGenerator.generate() accepted the invalid direct dataclass input.
issues.root_cause: ColumnTag validation only ran at construction; serializer and direct generator guards trusted already-created objects even if mutated later.
issues.resolution: ColumnTag.to_dict() now revalidates required string fields, and SQLGenerator direct validation calls the same serializer validation.
